Question 1
?

The geometric series 4+16+64+256+1024 can be written using sigma notation as

a
∑n=154⋅8n−1
b
∑n=158n−1
c
∑n=158⋅4n−1
d
∑n=154⋅4n−1
e
∑n=15(14)n−1
